competition_accounts_finalization_consis.name: competition_accounts_finalization_consistent
competition_accounts_finalization_consis.value: ("competition_accounts"."final_settled_balance_lamports" is null and "competition_accounts"."hourly_pnl_lamports" is null and "competition_accounts"."finalized_at" is null) or ("competition_accounts"."final_settled_balance_lamports" is not null and "competition_accounts"."hourly_pnl_lamports" = "competition_accounts"."final_settled_balance_lamports" - "competition_accounts"."starting_paper_sol_lamports" and "competition_accounts"."finalized_at" is not null)

daily_competitions_exact_utc_window.name: daily_competitions_exact_utc_window
daily_competitions_exact_utc_window.value: "daily_competitions"."starts_at" = date_trunc('day', "daily_competitions"."starts_at" at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC' and "daily_competitions"."ends_at_exclusive" = "daily_competitions"."starts_at" + interval '1 day' and "daily_competitions"."utc_date" = ("daily_competitions"."starts_at" at time zone 'UTC')::date

idempotency_completion_consistent.name: idempotency_completion_consistent
idempotency_completion_consistent.value: ("idempotency_records"."status" = 'PENDING' and "idempotency_records"."completed_at" is null) or ("idempotency_records"."status" <> 'PENDING' and "idempotency_records"."completed_at" is not null)

orders_request_valid.name: orders_request_valid
orders_request_valid.value: ("orders"."side" = 'BUY' and "orders"."requested_quote_lamports" > 0 and "orders"."requested_base_units" is null) or ("orders"."side" = 'SELL' and "orders"."requested_base_units" > 0 and "orders"."requested_quote_lamports" is null)

payout_plans_source_exact.name: payout_plans_source_exact
payout_plans_source_exact.value: ("payout_plans"."competition_type" = 'HOURLY' and "payout_plans"."hourly_round_id" is not null and "payout_plans"."daily_competition_id" is null) or ("payout_plans"."competition_type" = 'DAILY' and "payout_plans"."hourly_round_id" is null and "payout_plans"."daily_competition_id" is not null)

positions_state_consistent.name: positions_state_consistent
positions_state_consistent.value: ("positions"."status" = 'OPEN' and "positions"."remaining_base_units" > 0 and "positions"."cost_basis_lamports" > 0 and "positions"."closed_at" is null) or ("positions"."status" = 'CLOSED' and "positions"."remaining_base_units" = 0 and "positions"."cost_basis_lamports" = 0 and "positions"."closed_at" is not null)
